html:
PhD scholarships · 2027–28 entry

Round 1 supervisor nominations now close on 13 November 2026. The applicant deadline remains 2 November 2026. Later applicant deadlines are 11 January and 1 March 2027.

Bioengineering will put forward two President’s scholarship applicants per round and has four home EPSRC scholarships across the department. Overseas President’s nominations require the overseas fee component to be covered by the department or supervisory team. Discuss arrangements with Dandan.

Scholarship dates, eligibility and supervisor nomination guidance

Explore postgraduate research with the Multi-Scale Embodied Intelligence Lab, connecting sensing, learning, shared control and robot design to physical applications.

Discuss research fit

Email d.zhang17@imperial.ac.uk with your intended programme or visit, a focused research interest, CV, relevant work and proposed period. Include any funding route you are considering. Formal admission, project allocation and funding follow the relevant Imperial processes.
